baseline.worktree: Already contained uncommitted pass 13; not clean-release acceptance.
baseline.publication: No version change, commit, tag, push or deployment this pass.

workflows: F36 and F24/F25 panel isolation only
scope.meaning: Private metrics read, validation, hotspot rendering, polling/manual refresh, stale/unavailable/recovery and scope cancellation. Co-located panels are not a new map edge.
scope.boundaries: Actual React hooks, SettingsPage, panels, confirmation and i18n under Strict Mode; synthetic responses and controlled browser clock; non-fixture networking blocked.
excluded: Engine instrumentation or metrics semantics, APIs/schema, compiler strategy or authority changes
real deployment data/credentials, Engine/database, Agent, SSH/LAN/kernel operations

findings.observed: Malformed operation metrics crashed the settings tree.
findings.fix: Validate both snapshots before state publication and hotspot rendering; preserve neighboring form/Runner controls.

findings.observed: Stalled reads never aborted or released the metrics refresh slot.
findings.fix: Reuse private credentialed, no-store, redirect-error transport and ten-second header/body waiting, including abort-ignoring responses.

findings.observed: Navigation neither aborted the metrics read nor established a new owner.
findings.fix: Engine/navigation/effect generations own reads/results/timers; stale callbacks cannot publish or restart them.

findings.observed: Background failures kept old samples without errors and retained an earlier success message.
findings.fix: Generic visible error, clearly stale retained data and neutral non-current labels/colors; validated recovery clears failure.
Translate feedback keys during render, without making polling depend on translation callbacks.

findings.observed: Settings saving cleared an unrelated metrics error.
findings.fix: Remove cross-panel feedback clearing; metrics feedback lives in its own panel.

findings.observed: Pending settings reads disabled independent metrics refresh.
findings.fix: Refresh controls track only metrics request state.

semantics.manual_refresh: Coalesces while a read is active; completed reads restart the normal delay.
semantics.numeric_validation: Nonnegative safe integer counters and displayed aggregate sums; finite fractional latency <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER milliseconds. Ignore extra fields. Do not impose cross-counter ordering/equality on independent Engine samples.

baseline.meaning: First failing assertions only; later protective coverage is not independently reproduced before each fix.

diagnostics.note: Equivalent first baseline checked the new stale flag first; final baseline checks the missing existing error field first.
Test fixture incorrectly expected MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 0 to overflow; corrected to add one, without changing the decoder.

unit.overlap: Included in frontend gate count; not additive.

first_green.composition: Seven metrics baseline cases plus seventeen settings cases.

expanded_browser.composition: Fifteen metrics cases plus seventeen unchanged pass-13 settings cases.

production_page_subset.meaning: Local production Next server with intercepted synthetic Engine responses; not live Engine acceptance.

final_preflight.note: Rerun after interruption to confirm final documentation/course mirrors and formatting; no Rust compilation.

evidence.meaning: Selected final source fingerprints, not a full pre-fix or clean repository snapshot; pre-fix base includes preserved pass-13 evidence.

limitations: Metrics remain approximate in-process observations, not distributed tracing, Engine health/authorization proof or an atomic snapshot; a sample can age before the next poll.
Deadlines bound cooperative browser waiting, not CPU/event-loop stalls or server work.
Runner tests cover panel survival and normal reviewed cancellation during metrics failure, not its own decoding, deadlines, failed acknowledgements or navigation safety.
No Rust/SQL/SDK runtime tests, full project gate, remote CI, entire optional-browser suite, live browser-to-Engine integration, deployment/LAN/kernel acceptance or new benchmark.
next: F24/F25 Runner inventory and probe/cancel lifecycle: unconfirmed acknowledgements, stale inventory, timeouts and confirmation/navigation cancellation. Read-only code inspection identifies follow-up risks, not fixes or new reproduced findings.
